required_fields: Reported clinical phenotypes in affected individuals with Jaberi-Elahi syndrome (OMIM #617988, GTPBP2)
Frequencies for each phenotype as numerator and denominator per cohort (not percentage alone) attached to a resolvable source (PMID or DOI)
Original wording of each finding from the paper plus the standard HPO term if identifiable
Most discriminating findings present in most affected individuals but uncommon in overlapping disorders
Names of the disorders Jaberi-Elahi syndrome is usually confused with
Confidence level of the distinction between Jaberi-Elahi syndrome and the overlapping disorders
Findings looked for and found absent in affected individuals (whose presence argues against the diagnosis)
Evaluation of whether the phenotype differs by variant type, variant position, age, or sex
Findings reported in one paper that are explicitly contradicted by another
